name: data-standard-expert
description: Expert for health-information data standards: comparison, revision, DDL generation and schema verification, grounded in Chinese semantic mapping.

displayDescription.en: Expert for health-information data standards: comparison, revision, DDL generation and schema verification, grounded in Chinese semantic mapping.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据需求号修订这份标准，并生成修订记录脚本
